_classes.name: named authority in a Public Authorities Law section resolved to the generic 'Local agencies and authorities' group
_classes.rule: re.fullmatch(r'(the|such) authority', actor_raw, I) and agency=='Local agencies and authorities' and 'Public Authorities Law' in citation

_classes.name: grant_only kind gate flips a cap or prohibition ('no ... may', 'no more than ... may') from duty to power
_classes.rule: kind_adjusted=='grant_only' and kind_model=='duty' and re.search(r'\b(no|not|no more than)\b[^.;]{0,120}\bmay\b|\bmay not\b', quote, I)

_classes.name: reprinted actor kept when braces only add a second actor (AG copy survives while reprinted_name_swap drops its sibling)
_classes.rule: stored record whose (matter_id, agency) matches a dropped reprinted_name_swap record and whose exact quote is shared, in the same law, with a stored record of a different agency

_classes.name: sunset-extension law left with zero extends records after re-ask (a_numbers_only_fewer_extends), incl. holders named in the act clause
_classes.rule: law keys in data/reask/*.json with check a_numbers_only_fewer_extends and no stored record with extends_existing true (count is laws, examples are law keys)

_classes.name: condition_of_other_record drops a main 'shall' duty (S523 'a court of this state shall recognize')
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='condition_of_other_record' and quote has 'shall' and lacks until|unless|approval|approved|subject to (dropped ids, candidates for review)

_classes.name: reworded reprint of an existing power stored as a record
